# stb_image

Unmodified `stb_image.h` (v2.30) and `LICENSE` from the official repository at
commit `f0569113c93ad095470c54bf34a17b36646bbbb5`:
https://github.com/nothings/stb/tree/f0569113c93ad095470c54bf34a17b36646bbbb5

Afterlight chooses the MIT license option. `engine/src/image.c` compiles the
implementation as C, restricted to PNG, JPEG, BMP and TGA with an 8192 dimension
limit. CPU file loading and errors are handled separately in `engine/src/asset.c`.
